name: Diatonic Chord
author: Tom Burns
description: Chords stacked in scale degrees rather than fixed intervals, so the quality follows the played note. From Tom Burns' Braids Renaissance firmware.

controls.label: Chord
controls.description: Steps through sixteen chord shapes, from triads up through elevenths and the suspended set.

controls.label: Spread
controls.description: Detunes the voices against each other, and folds them where the waveform is still a sine.

controls.label: Waveform
controls.description: Morphs every voice from sine through triangle and saw to square.

controls.label: Scale
controls.description: Selects the scale the chord is built from, which is what decides its quality.

outputs.aux: The root voice alone, as a pitch reference.
